experimental_method: Static batch cell with mechanical agitation in an air bath; phases sampled under equilibrium pressure; propane dehydrated (Dehydrite) and measured in a calibrated glass bottle, water determined gravimetrically/by difference; propane-water system only.
uncertainties_stated: Thermocouples calibrated to 0.1 F; pressure gauges within +-1% of readings (0-150 psi gage), +-0.667% (0-1000 psi gage), +-0.5% (0-3000 psi gage).
quality_remarks: Propane not less than 99 mole %, impurities mainly ethane and isobutane (about 0.2%). Table I includes critical-region rows (footnote a) and an extrapolated quadruple point (footnote b). Temperature scale not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table IV (p. 444): graphically smoothed three-phase data, derived
Table V (p. 444): graphically smoothed water content of propane-rich phases, derived
Table VI (p. 445/446): graphically smoothed propane solubility in water-rich phase, derived (not opened as data)
extraction_notes: Table I printed as three stacked blocks with sub-headings; written as table_1_group1/2/3 (different value definitions). Text layer clean; every cell compared against the 200 dpi page image and 2x crops. Pressures in psia, temperatures in F, mole fractions. Table II/III row regimes are overrides inferred from Table I/IV (flagged). Sanity: temperature monotonic within blocks; Table III propane mole fraction increases with pressure along isotherms; Table II water content decreases with pressure along isotherms. Printed 'Temp.' in Table I group2 202.1 and 206.1 carry footnote a.
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer clean and every cell matched the image.
pass2_diff: Tables I-III: 158 rows, 474/474 numbers identical. Table I vapour row 201.7 F / 612 psia: a blot covers the last digit of 0.01208; both readers read 8 (second reader about 85 percent sure).
